about: Captured quality pool-metro question from CI run 41003648273 (30 Oct 2026, ap PR #2565). The same five Swiss place patterns as quality-country-ask.json, asked under the metro task; the country miss hid it until the country rows landed. Authored metro verdicts, not recorded model output. Preserves exact task, schema and item bytes from the refusal artifact.

context.task: A place a job seeker searches in. Answer its metro area, or none when it is a whole country, a region, or a place outside these areas.
